mapper.select:
SELECT l.*, fs.name AS from_store_name, ts.name AS to_store_name, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name FROM dist_store_ledger l LEFT JOIN store_info fs ON fs.id = l.from_store_id LEFT JOIN store_info ts ON ts.id = l.to_store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = l.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = l.to_warehouse_id
ORDER BY l.biz_date DESC, l.id DESC

SELECT g.from_store_id, fs.name AS from_store_name, g.to_store_id, ts.name AS to_store_name, g.entry_count, g.cost_amount, g.amount FROM (SELECT l.from_store_id, l.to_store_id, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.cost_amount), 0) AS cost_amount, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS amount FROM dist_store_ledger l
GROUP BY l.from_store_id, l.to_store_id) g LEFT JOIN store_info fs ON fs.id = g.from_store_id LEFT JOIN store_info ts ON ts.id = g.to_store_id ORDER BY fs.sort, g.from_store_id, ts.sort, g.to_store_id
